note: Visual-composition outcome corpus for the mobile sheet (FIX-DS-06.03, finding DS-06/XD-13; third sibling, after fix-ds-06.01.json (quiet dashboard) and fix-ds-06.02.json (consumer chat)). The same two judged layers stay SEPARATE: routing/constraint/provenance correctness is judged deterministically on artifacts here; the VISUAL outcome is judged by an independent render rubric against the actual render at the same viewport and content — that live model/render eval is a SEPARATE authorized execution batch after implementation, which no fixture task imitates. A correct render is NOT obliged to change; a mechanical PASS never substitutes for composition judgement; a fault names a region and what is wrong, never only a token/style name; a claimed screenshot must EXIST as a decodable file (a mention is not a file); an offline/no-keys route reports NOT_RUN and proposes no install; 100% structural PASS is never phrased as a proven design improvement — comparison stays UNMEASURED until the authorized run (identical inputs/budget/viewports, blind order, repeated samples, failures/cost/time recorded).

prompt.text: Review an already-correct full-height mobile sheet (grabber present, drawer easing per the pack, safe-area respected). Identity-preserving: a correct render is NOT obliged to change — record kept/changed per region with a reason into sheet-review.md; zero changes with reasons is a valid outcome.

Stress the sheet at viewport 390x844 with the SAME content fixture both arms use: content shorter than half the sheet, content exceeding the sheet (internal scroll), and a keyboard opening under an input inside the sheet. Write sheet-stress.md naming the faults on the actual render — a fault names a region and what is wrong, never only a token/style name.

Judge the sheet's dismiss paths (grabber drag, scrim tap, back gesture) and the DUR-SHEET-MOBILE duration band on the actual render — the composition question no token check answers. Write dismiss-review.md; a mechanical token PASS does not close this review.

Review the mobile sheet WITHOUT any screenshot or render available: every claim that needs the render is marked NOT_RUN (what it would take), and no screenshot path is cited as existing. Write render-review.md.

Check the sheet under the platform's Reduce Motion at the same viewport and content: the drawer transition degrades to a calm state change and the sheet stays fully usable; parity faults name the region and both behaviours. Write motion-parity.md.
